description: This file defines the RGraph.CSV class for parsing CSV data, including custom splitting, fetching data via AJAX or from DOM, and retrieving rows and columns.

classes.name: RGraph.CSV
classes.description: Class for loading and parsing CSV data, with methods for fetching, splitting, and retrieving data rows and columns.

methods.name: splitCSV
methods.description: Custom CSV string splitter handling quotes and delimiters.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Loads CSV data either from DOM element or via AJAX, parses it, and calls the ready callback.

methods.name: getRow
methods.description: Returns a specific row of CSV data.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Returns a specific column of CSV data.
